g.text: Holding versus equal-duration straight flight | all 12 scenes
Full dose range; each selected aircraft receives 240 seconds at the trajectory endpoint
Dashed line: archived common cutoff, where available; later doses remain visible. Crosses at bottom mark failed order-dose fits.
R² ≥ 0.98 throughout. Five orders are dependent repeats. Lines break at NA; medians may use different available orders at each dose.
